title: Build the supply-tax Focus Deck exemplar

progress.summary: Baseline reconciled and verified: approved Focus Deck variants, routes, clock endpoint behavior, project direction, and control records are isolated for commit; unrelated worktree edits remain untouched.

expectedLearning: Whether discrete semantic snaps make a multifaceted graph-and-welfare change easier to compare, replay, and inspect than continuous scrollytelling.
allowedWork: One exact-rational, Article-backed, eight-beat native SVG and KaTeX supply-tax Focus Deck using the existing reader clock.
disallowedWork: Shared Focus Deck extraction, generalized tax or Graph2D grammar, custom search, duplicate prose, controls, unrelated exemplar changes, or promotion before human review.
